name: riven-postban-shattered-confirm2-g4
description: Riven after the bans of 23 Nov 2026 (lab/meta/ban_watch_2026-11-13.md), champion Riven, Shattered: card-level search (lab/deckopt.py) from the tournament Riven main decks with their banned cards replaced and four hand-built lists, against a field without the banned cards (Kai'Sa 51, Kennen 44, the two post-ban Riven frames 20 each, Master Yi 16, Rek'Sai 10, Akali 8, Volibear 8; lists patched by lab/tools/postban.py). Exploration and races with the cheap pilot (sims=4, worlds=2), confirmation with the full one. The Riven pilot spec_riven_120_v0 has never played this champion: provisional until the pilot trained on these variations confirms it (stage confirm2). Jeremy, 13 Nov: 'lance des simu cette nuit'. Stage confirm2: 4 lists on the same seeds, 2400 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Riven Deserter (post-ban frame) 272 games, Rek'Sai (Rajan Nandan) 136 games, Akali (Vincent Nguyen, post-ban) 108 games.
